name: merge
summary: Interleave two sorted slices into one sorted Vec — the merge step of merge sort, taken in isolation.
vizCode: ({ datatype: 'array', input: [1,4,7,2,3,9], run(a) { const mid = 3; const left = []; const right = []; for (let i=0;i<mid;i++) left.push(a.get(i)); for (let i=mid;i<a.length;i++) right.push(a.get(i)); let i=0,j=0,k=0; while (i<left.length && j<right.length) { a.cursor('i',i); a.cursor('j',j); if (left[i] <= right[j]) { a.set(k, left[i]); a.mark(k,'from-a'); i++; } else { a.set(k, right[j]); a.mark(k,'from-b'); j++; } k++; } while (i<left.length) { a.set(k, left[i]); a.mark(k,'from-a'); i++; k++; } while (j<right.length) { a.set(k, right[j]); a.mark(k,'from-b'); j++; k++; } a.markSorted(); } })
